name: photo-time-machine-desktop
description: Photo Time Machine desktop app (Tauri 2). A standalone npm project, not a workspace: it bundles the viewer build in web-server/client/build and never imports the viewer's code.

scripts.build:web: cd .. && npm run build && node scripts/check-app-viewer.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run notices && npm run icons && tauri build
